title: Stretch: `stratum-cli board` to view this Epic/ folder as a sprint board

user_story.i_want: a CLI that reads the Epic/ JSON files and prints the board grouped by status
user_story.so_that: I practise serde and the filesystem on data I already own, and I can see the sprint without opening files

description: A synchronous warm-up before the async-heavy epics. Walk `Epic/**/main.json`, deserialize stories into structs (reuse field names from the JSON), and print columns Backlog / To Do / In Progress / In Review / Done for a chosen sprint, with point totals. Flag stories whose blockers aren't Done.

acceptance_criteria.then: stories appear grouped by status with points per column

acceptance_criteria.given: a story blocked by an unfinished story

acceptance_criteria.then: it reports the file path and the serde error instead of panicking

references.title: The Rust Book ch.13: Closures & iterators
